name: grok2api-stability-probe
title: Grok2api Stability Probe
description: Build a reusable probe in experiments/ that reproduces EoH's multi-process grok2api workload, measure empty-content rate, transport error rate, latency, and the client-concurrency + server-worker stability envelope. First round runs on heyun to give the next 3G EoH campaign concrete EXP_N_PROC and SERVER_WORKERS guidance.
